banner.title: <1>Words</1> shared across your data
banner.sub: The <1>kinds of data and fields</1> collected automatically from what you have added. The more the names line up, the better questions and comparisons work across datasets.
banner.fixNote: To change the name of a word, open that dataset and use "Revise the design".

map.title: Map of shared words
map.lead: Your datasets' kinds and fields become one map. The more datasets connect, the more this map grows. The band at the bottom holds the world's standard vocabularies — the more lines gather there, the better your data speaks with the world.
map.bandHint: The more lines gather here, the more your words connect with the world
map.unavailable: Couldn't draw the map right now — the datasets' ingest rules could not be read. Wait a moment and reload the page.

schemaError: Couldn't load the list of words. Wait a moment, then press "Reload". If it keeps happening, tell whoever set this server up.

classesCard.title: Words in use right now
classesCard.note1: The number on the right = the count. <1>Kinds count how many things of that kind exist</1>, <3>fields count how often they are used</3>.
classesCard.note2: * Only <1>published (citable) data</1> is counted. Unpublished drafts are not included — they enter the tally once published.
classesCard.emptyAll: There is no published data yet, so there are no words yet. Publish data via "Add data" and it will appear here.

usersCard.title: Datasets using these words
usersCard.empty: No datasets yet. Add a file from "Add data" and it will appear here.
usersCard.draftNote: Once published, its words also appear in the list on the left.

caution.body: The words listed here are shared by several datasets. Renaming one affects search and answers for every dataset that uses it.

known.prov: PROV-O (who made the data, and how)
known.qudt: QUDT (standard words for quantities and units)
known.skos: SKOS (grouping terms and their alternative names)
known.cmso: CMSO (shared words for crystal structure, composition and defects)
